title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via readObject (java) — review required
description: In java, readObject performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The java-specific remedy is data-only decoding via a data-only format with explicit field mapping.
applicability: java codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through readObject; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
